title: Saudi East-West pipeline — the outer bound of the officials' 3-5 week repair window closes
source: NEWS: Saudi Arabia shut the East-West crude pipeline on 2026-09-10 after multiple drone attacks; two officials speaking to the Associated Press put repairs at three to five weeks, relayed by Middle East Eye ('Saudi East-West oil pipeline may take up to five weeks to repair, officials say') and investinglive ('Saudi east-west pipeline will be out of service for 3-5 weeks - report'), both surfaced 2026-09-15. The DATE IS DERIVED, and that is the whole reason it is `estimate`: 2026-10-15 is five weeks from the 09-10 shutdown, the outer bound of an officials' RANGE relayed through the press, not a milestone anyone has announced. No Saudi government statement naming a restart date was found. Corroborating market read, fetched DIRECT from polymarket.com/event/saudi-oil-pipeline-east-west-restarts-byptptpt on 2026-09-15: restart-by 2026-09-15 at 1% ($60,352), restart-by 2026-09-30 at 40% ($115,638), $175,991 total book, market end date 2026-10-01, resolving on a Saudi government announcement that the pipeline 'is presently operating' (partial capacity qualifies). A search summary relaying 63% for that same 09-30 leg did not reconcile with the direct read and was discarded. Checked 2026-09-15
notes: This calendar tracks NO entry of any kind for the outage that moved Brent from $97.92 (09-08) to $107.81 (09-15 live), +10.1% in a week — the only oil events in the jobs-2026-10-02 corridor are OPEC's own meetings (opec-plus-meeting-2026-10-04, opec-jmmc-68th-2026-10-04), which price policy, not this supply break. Why a payroll sweep filed it: the energy shock is the inflation half of the stagflation pairing every ledger in this corridor names (soft labour 10/02 + hot CPI 10/14), it is the driver the press has rotated to from labour, and the restart book prices ~60% that the premium is still on the tape two days before the 2026-10-02 Employment Situation — i.e. it sits on the entire September reference month that print measures. What the date is FOR, stated plainly so nobody reads more into it than it carries: it is the line past which a still-shut pipeline stops being a transient repair and starts being a structural supply premium, and it lands one day after cpi-2026-10-14. It is not a scheduled release, a vote, or an announcement. Filed `medium`, not `high`: a single pipeline outage with a stated repair path is smaller than a scheduled macro print, and the date is derived rather than published — an event whose own date is an inference should not also carry a high-impact tier. Any lane that finds a Saudi government statement naming an actual restart or completion date should file THAT as the canonical entry and let this proposal go inert. Discovered during the jobs-2026-10-02 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-09-15).
